Supporting a lower-carbon port.

Energy Infrastructure

The grid-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) at the Port of Gladstone, Queensland, Australia, is a flagship project supporting the vision of a green and low-carbon port. With an installed capacity of 125 MW and an energy storage capacity of 500 MWh, the system can supply electricity to approximately 35,000 Australian households with a single full charge. It will also provide reliable power support to the Port of Gladstone, helping to facilitate the smooth delivery of the port’s upgrade program.

The Port of Gladstone, located in Queensland, Australia, is approximately 430 kilometres north of Brisbane. The target site, identified as Area A in the company profile, covers approximately 30,000 square metres.

Scope and delivery

  • Grid-scale battery storage
  • Port energy infrastructure
  • Energy project development
